definitions.explanation: A mistake where something important is missed or not noticed. Refers to the act of overlooking or to the thing that was missed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見落|みお}とし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Check the documents for any oversights.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{見落|みお}とし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A small oversight can lead to a big mistake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}した→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{見落|みお}とし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I reread it many times, but there were still things I missed.

notes:
Noun form derived from the verb ⟦{見落|みお}とす→見落とす：04578_miotosu⟧ (to overlook, to miss). Commonly used in work and professional contexts when checking for errors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見落|みお}とし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is an oversight)
- {見落|みお}とし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (check for oversights)
- ⟦{重大|じゅうだい}→重大：01641_juudai⟧な{見落|みお}とし (a serious oversight)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見逃|みのが}し→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧: missing something (can imply intentionally letting it pass)
- ⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧: mistake (broader, includes all types of errors)
